Continue existing evidence, repair-or-close, measurement, parked-site, legal, security, and attribution work. Keep permission outreach unsent pending human-counsel review.

Reject the proposed bounded site-factory pipeline as duplicate and not queue-eligible. Retain CRO and repository opportunities as deferred research backlog only. No new implementation or production proposal is supported this cycle.
